items.title: test(database): PostgreSQL search product-flow conformance (#174462)
items.summary: test(database): PostgreSQL search product-flow conformance (#174462) * test(database): PostgreSQL search product-flow conformance Exercise public memory, transcript, and standing-intent flows on PostgreSQL. Enable standing-intent search through registered engine projections, resolve custom session stores asynchronously, and bound memory queries and results. Preserve SQLite search behavior and document engine-local ranking, extension requirements, and the existing bounded transcript-visibility contract. * fix(database): preserve session ownership during search preparation Keep canonical session writes in their existing FIFO before yielding while resolving custom PostgreSQL store ownership through the read worker. Capture routing before discovery and await Doctor reader retirement at finalization. Extend public vector and sessions_search conformance, and repair maintenance test completion and cleanup so they observe the owning workers. * fix(sessions): preserve captured write environment during preparation * test(gateway): prepare runtime config for native session controls * test: prune retired session scope mock allowances * fix(sessions): preserve shared-store patch admission order
